positions.name: Paramount Skydance
positions.catalyst: Settled the 12-state AG antitrust suit AND the Writers Guild suit on Sept 21 - the only two remaining barriers to closing the $110B Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition (EU and UK already cleared). Paramount said earlier this month all other closing conditions were satisfied. PSKY FELL 2.9% Monday while WBD rose 11%, so the acquirer has not repriced. +2.22% pre-market. EXIT TRIGGER: close on announcement of deal completion, or on any court refusing to approve the consent decree.
positions.risks: Settlement is subject to court approval and carries real cost: $300M+ per year of incremental US film production for five years, 30-32 movies annually, a three-year freeze on theater rate increases, a $47.5M worker fund and a news editorial-independence board over CBS and CNN. Tender/exchange offers for Discovery notes were extended to Oct 2 with only 66.87%/75.12% tendered as of Sept 18. Negative trailing earnings (PE -17.6).
positions.driver: Final antitrust barrier to the $110B WBD close removed
